name: MIRR.AI
tagline: A virtual wardrobe and try-on browser extension inspired by the computer closet in a 1990s film.
problem: Online clothing has high return rates and costs, much of it from fit, the team cites.
solution: A browser extension and app that manages your wardrobe and lets you try products on virtually before buying.
demo_moment: Team-described: try on a product page item over your own photo.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of MongoDB Atlas” among 127 submissions.
Names a beloved film scene as the product.

lessons: A shared pop-culture image explains the product before the demo.
